headline: Best spot of the day — chest-high S swell with light cross wind most of the day.
today: Solid setup out east: 2-2.8ft of S swell at a good angle and the wind stays light 5-6mph cross right through the afternoon, so it stays clean and rideable much of the day. Fish or shortboard, and the incoming push toward the 4:53 high should have the most punch. Best all-around window of the three spots.

daysToWatch.note: Building to 3ft-plus with more period behind it, cross-on SW stays manageable in the morning. Fun size — surf before the wind grows into the evening.
Biggest at 2.4-3.2ft but the wind ramps from 12mph to 17mph SW as the day goes — dawn patrol only, then it deteriorates.
Cleanest wind of the stretch: NW offshore to light morning over chest-high swell. Worth an early look.
